products.product_description: Honey Roasted Peanuts, net wt. 11 oz.., packed in a clear plastic bag. Ingredients: peanuts, sugar, peanut and/or canola and/or cottonseed oil, honey, salt, modified potato starch, xanthan gum. Allergen info: peanut and soy ingredients. Also states that facility also processes products containing, milk and wheat ingredients. Distributed by: Dutch Valley Food Distributors Inc., Myerstown, PA 17067.
products.code_info: All products with UPC code 8 77245 00143 3 and Best By date up to 1/21/14.
products.reason_for_recall: Honey Roasted Peanuts were recalled due to undeclared milk (lactose) and wheat (wheat starch) allergens in the ingredient statement.

products.product_description: Roasted Salted Mixed Nuts w/ Peanuts, net wt. 12 oz., packed in a clear plastic bag. Ingredients: blanched peanuts, unblanched peanuts, unblanched almonds, unblanched Brazil nuts, unblanched filberts, cashews cooked in canola oil, salt. Allergen info: peanut and tree nuts (almonds, Brazil nuts, filberts, cashews). Labeling also states that the facility also processes products containing tree nuts. Distributed by Dutch Valley Food Distributors Inc., Myerstown, PA 17067.
products.code_info: All products with UPC code 8 77245 00140 2 and Best By date up to 1/21/14.
products.reason_for_recall: Roasted Salted Mixed Nuts with Peanuts were recalled for undeclared tree nuts (pecans) in the ingredient statement.
